subject: Web Development
title: Flash and the Multimedia Web
description: A quick win: understand Flash and the Multimedia Web.

hook.text: In the late 90s, the web couldn't play video, animate smoothly, or run games.

buildup.text: Macromedia Flash filled every gap with animation, sound, and rich interactivity.

discovery.text: Entire websites were built in Flash — immersive experiences impossible with HTML.

twist.text: Flash didn't work on iPhones. Steve Jobs wrote an open letter refusing to support it.

climax.text: Adobe killed Flash in 2020. The open web standards it inspired had already replaced it.

punchline.text: Flash showed what the web could be, then died.
